bio_am: Ծնած է Վան՝ 1882-ին։ Վասպուրականի 1915-ի հերոսամարտի ղեկավարներէն, մահացած է Թեհրան՝ 1968-ին։
bio_en: Haykak Kosoyan was born in Van in 1882 and studied there and at the Gevorgian seminary in Etchmiadzin. He taught in Van, directed the school at Aghtamar and worked as an educator in the Gavash and Karchkan districts, later teaching in Tabriz and Tehran. Joining the ARF young, he served on the Van committee, the Shamiram and Atrpatakan central committees and the party bodies in Tehran, and was one of the leaders of the heroic defence of Vaspurakan in 1915. He died in Tehran on 24 November 1968 after a long illness.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: high. Death year from the obituary in Alik, 4 Jan 1969 (died 24 November, i.e. 1968). Author of the memoir #78 on Aram.
